subject: Re: BridgeWorks - urgent connector errors and SLA handoff
messages:
From: Evan Patel <evan.patel@bridgeworks.systems>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: support@bridgeworks.systems
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Connector failures causing customer incidents

Hi Aditya,

We started seeing repeated 502/timeout errors coming from the Redwood connector in our EU customers' flows this morning. Two customers have already opened incident tickets — they reported tokenization hangs when sequences exceed ~4k tokens. We collected logs and a small export attached.

Can your team confirm whether this is an infra rollout, a model change, or a routing policy issue? The incidents are blocking our weekend rollout and our customer success team is escalating.

Attachments: BridgeWorks_Support_Log.zip (zip), connector-error-sample-20251104.txt (plain)

Thanks,
Evan
Director, Platform Integrations
BridgeWorks Systems
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Evan Patel <evan.patel@bridgeworks.systems>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Connector failures causing customer incidents

Thanks for the heads-up, Evan — sorry you're seeing this. I pulled the logs you attached and opened an internal incident. Initial read: there are a couple of request paths hitting a quantization codepath that hasn't been exercised at that sequence length on our latest kernel build; under burst the routing fallback to the cheaper variant isn't triggering quickly enough which can cause transient 502s.

Immediate plan:
- Marissa (Partnerships Eng) and Camila (Runtime Ops) are looping in to coordinate a partner-focused rollback/fallback policy for BridgeWorks traffic.
- We’ll deploy a targeted routing rule to send BridgeWorks EU traffic to the stable variant within 30 minutes.
- We'll follow up with a postmortem and action items for a safer rollout cadence.

I’ll update once we confirm the routing change. For now, please escalate any urgent customer tickets to the shared support alias; we’ll prioritize.

—Aditya
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Patel <evan.patel@bridgeworks.systems>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 10:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Connector failures causing customer incidents

Camila — quick sync: can we make the following changes and confirm timings?

Ask list (short):
1) Push routing override for BridgeWorks (account tag BRG-3421) -> stable-model-2025-10 within 30m.
2) Enable stricter sequence-length guard on the partner path to force local truncation / 4k cap as a temporary safeguard.
3) Add a KV-cache warmup for BridgeWorks bursts to reduce cold-start tokenization overhead.
4) Post-deploy healthcheck that runs the sample payloads in connector-error-sample-20251104.txt (I attached the file Evan sent).

If we can get 1+2 live quickly we'll likely stop the customer incidents. Camila, shout if you need an owner for rollback.

—Marissa
Director, Partnerships Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Patel <evan.patel@bridgeworks.systems>, support@bridgeworks.systems
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 10:50:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Connector failures causing customer incidents

Acknowledged. We're rolling the routing override now and will enable the sequence-length guard in the partner path. ETA for routing change: 23 minutes.

Notes for the incident log (internal):
- Temporary routing rule will pin BRG-3421 to stable-model-2025-10 for EU region only.
- Will monitor tail latency and 502 rate; if error rate drops below 0.5% in 15 minutes we'll keep the override in place and start KV warmup.
- If anything regresses we revert to previous routing and open an infra ticket for kernel rollback.

I'll post the healthcheck results to the Jira above once done.

—Camila
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Evan Patel <evan.patel@bridgeworks.systems>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Nov 2025 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Connector failures causing customer incidents

Thanks all — appreciation for the quick triage. Our CS team confirmed the EU incidents cleared within ~12 minutes after the routing override. Two quick follow-ups:

- Can we formalize an SLA addendum for BridgeWorks that specifies partner-specific routing overrides and a 30-minute mitigation target for P1 integration incidents? We need this for our internal compliance before the customer rollout next month.
- We’d like a short runbook describing the sequence-length guard and the KV warmup toggle so our SREs can validate during smoke tests.

If you prefer, we can run this as a brief working session next week; let me know availability.

Regards,
Evan
Director, Platform Integrations
BridgeWorks Systems
